title: capability_trial output
description: Try a provider's capability on one synthetic input before connecting, against an expectation of what an acceptable output would be. The network carries the call, with dry_run set when the capability takes an external action, so the provider's endpoint stays private, scores the output against the expectation and the provider's own output schema, and answers a match score: never the output. Trials carry execution_kind=trial: never customer evidence or a charge.

status.description: succeeded when the provider returned an output that was scored; failed when the provider received the call and failed (it counts toward the trial limits and scores 0); refused when the call never reached the provider (it does not count).

score.description: The weighted mean of the checks that could be scored, rounded down to a step of 0.05. null when none could be scored, and when none of the consumer's own checks could be: the provider's output schema alone never makes a pass. 0 for a failed trial.

match.description: The score as a percentage match with the expected output, 0 to 100, rounded; null when the trial has no score.

passed.description: Whether the score reached the threshold; never true when the score is null.

checks.description: Empty from EKP 3.6: a trial answers only whether it passed, its score and its match, never each check's score. Kept so 3.5 clients still find it.

score.description: Rounded down to a step of 0.25, so one check says little about one value; null when it could not be scored.

reason.description: matched, near (partly, close to the bound), mismatch, out_of_range, missing (nothing at the path), wrong_type, judged (scored by the model) or cannot_tell (left out of the mean, never a fail).

error_code.description: When failed or refused: the provider's error code, or how the call ended, as a code of capital letters, digits and underscores. Never the provider's message, which could carry part of an output.

compiled.description: An expectation given in words, as the network compiled it, to keep and refine.
